events.title: Your Feedback and What to Expect Next
events.summary: The October edition of the Next Fest is just around the corner. But a few of you have played the demo already, and gave me a lot of food for thought!First of all, big Thank You to everyone who decided to spend some time in my casual and chill puzzle game, building traffic lights and ladybugs. You giving the game a time of your day is encouraging and uplifting. events.title: Demo Update 0.8.3
events.summary: The more people play, the more I learn about my own game.For example, ladybugs have been bugging out in their puzzle. If you've tried to place them on their layer as hard as you might and to no avail, rejoice! Because that issue should be resolved now.ChangelogFixedAn invalid detection of ladybug pieces in the "Ladybug Fields" puzzle.

events.title: Demo Update 0.8.2
events.summary: A quick update to celebrate the demo release!It has been an exciting day, full of valuable feedback already. One of the most obvious issues players are having with the demo right now is not being able to intuit some of the gameplay mechanics.Well, no worries! FOLLOW THESE STEPS is all about following step-by-step instructions, and so with this update you will have more instructions to follow.
